kind: Ideal passive seriesRLC calculation AFTER an assumed successful SCRtrip, not complete circuit simulation

equations.resistor_energy: 0.5*C*V0^2 for ideal complete discharge, with zero initial inductor current and no other dissipation

limitations: SCR alreadyon assumed; trigger delay, gate/hold/reset, diode behavior and active converter feed not modeled.

110V remains a screening voltage, not proven OVPmaximum.
No hotplug permission: reconnect before trip/discharge and contactbounce remain separate blockers.
Resistor pulse rating, repetitive fault energy, SCR/diode SOA, thermal and component tolerances must be qualified.
